evidence: On torch 2.5.1+cpu, torch.jit.save(scripted_model) fails with RuntimeError: Could not export Python function call 'is_fx_tracing'. The traceback points to codebase/detectron2/modeling/poolers.py:223 inside ROIPooler.forward.
steps: Run setup_env.sh to create or reuse the local virtualenv and install the pinned runtime dependencies.
Export PYTHONPATH to include the local codebase/ tree.
Execute repro.py, which builds the local Mask R-CNN config, scripts it with scripting_with_instances(), and fails during torch.jit.save().
